alsoGreen.intent: Structured Text instead of Ladder: a TOF and a TON called as function blocks

files.src/DelaysLd.st:
PROGRAM DelaysLd
VAR_INPUT Button AT %I0.0 : BOOL; Sensor AT %I0.1 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR_OUTPUT Light AT %Q0.0 : BOOL; Confirmed AT %Q0.1 : BOOL; END_VAR
VAR HoldTimer : TOF; FilterTimer : TON; END_VAR
HoldTimer(IN := Button, PT := T#300ms); Light := HoldTimer.Q;
FilterTimer(IN := Sensor, PT := T#200ms); Confirmed := FilterTimer.Q;
END_PROGRAM

wrong.intent: uses the two timers the wrong way round: TON for the hold and TOF for the filter
uses presets that are too short: 100 ms for the hold and 50 ms for the filter
delays the light but not the sensor: Confirmed follows Sensor
delays the sensor but not the light: Light follows Button
